p: top of the hill: Which was the hill of olives, 2Sa 15:30.
asses be for the king's household: Commonly there are no viler traitors than they, who under the pretence of friendship accuse others.
Bahurim: Which was a city in the tribe of Benjamin.
right hand and on his left: That is, round about him.
blood of the house of Saul: Reproaching him, as though by his means Ishbosheth and Abner were slain.
said unto him: David felt that this was the judgment of God for his sin, and therefore humbles himself to his rod.
requite me good for his cursing: Meaning, that the Lord will send comfort to his, when they are oppressed.

Ahithophel said unto Absalom: Suspecting the change of the kingdom, and so his own overthrow, he gives such counsel as might most hinder his father's reconciliation: and also declare to the people that Absalom was in highest authority.
enquired at the oracle of God: It was so esteemed for the success of it.
